about: Driver records that are one person entered twice, or a row whose name was parsed wrong. Each row folds the `from` record into the `to` record in the canonical dataset (scripts/backfill-driver-identities.mjs), so counts, shared races and head-to-heads see one driver. The test for a merge: the same car number or the same uncommon chassis, the same series and seasons, and never both in one session. Records that only look alike stay apart and are listed under `heldApart`.
